tasks.spec:
You are a probe-script author on freytag-forge. Working directory: the real repository /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. Use .venv/bin/python with PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge and TMPDIR=/tmp; never use uv; run pytest with -n0. THIS TASK MAKES NO NETWORK OR BILLED CALLS and uses no credentials: do not source .env. No git add/commit/reset/clean/checkout/stash/push. You own ONLY scripts/ringer/stage7/segment_replay_probe.py, scripts/ringer/stage7/test_segment_replay_probe.py, and files under bench/results/stage7-segment-replay-dry/. Do not edit any other file.

QUESTION. In the Stage 7 details N=12 run the Cloudflare narration worker returned replies the runtime had to repair: 7 of 8 warnings were a stray extra object {selected_knowledge_ids: [...]} inside the segments array (a fourth segment with no kind or text), and 1 was a segment object with keys kind,text whose kind value is not narration, dialogue or action. The runtime drops such segments (CloudflareTurnProvider._salvage_malformed_segments in storygame/runtime/cloudflare.py) but never records the raw reply. We need the raw replies. This probe replays three real narrator prompts many times and saves the raw worker body of every reply that fails schema validation.

BUILD scripts/ringer/stage7/segment_replay_probe.py, run as `TMPDIR=/tmp PYTHONPATH=$PWD .venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/stage7/segment_replay_probe.py --n N --out DIR [--dry-run] [--confirm]`.
1. PROMPT CAPTURE (free, offline). Read bench/core.py (load_variation, package_and_state, provider_for) and scripts/ringer/stage7/door_transport.py and door_continuation.py for how a provider is built and called in this repo. For variation bench/variations/stage7-door-grounded.json build a fresh scene-2B state with package_and_state(variation, '2B'), build the provider with provider_for, set provider.semantic_ask = None, and for each cell command run ONE engine turn through RuntimeEngine while monkeypatching storygame.runtime.cloudflare.urlopen with a stub that records the JSON request payload (system, user, max_tokens, response_format, as sent to the worker) and returns a minimal valid worker reply so no network is touched. Look at how existing tests (tests/test_cloudflare_transport.py _Response) shape a worker reply. The three cells and commands are: 'reveal' = "Search the selection files for Michelle's file." (this should offer reveal k_sl_2b_a_r1; assert the captured user prompt names that id or its offered-reveal block, and report if not), 'dialogue' = 'Ask Brandon what he remembers about the program.', 'plain' = 'Look around the archive.'. Save each captured payload to DIR/prompts/<cell>.json. Each cell uses a fresh state so the three prompts are independent.
2. REPLAY (billed, only with --confirm). Replay each captured payload N times to the worker exactly as scripts/ringer/stage7/2c_replay_probe.py does (urllib POST to CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_URL with BROWSER_USER_AGENT from storygame.runtime.cloudflare, optional CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_TOKEN bearer, same payload fields, 60 s timeout), rep-major interleaved across the cells. Read the env vars only inside the script; never print them. HARD CAP: at most 60 worker calls in total, enforced inside the script before each call; refuse --n over 20; no retries; on any HTTP, quota or malformed-body error record it in that row and keep going, but stop at the cap. For each reply store the VERBATIM raw body string in DIR/replies.jsonl (one JSON object per row: cell, rep, raw_body, error). Classify each row offline with the real validators: parse the worker body the way CloudflareTurnProvider does (read the provider's reply-unwrapping code and reuse its helpers where they exist rather than copying logic), then validate each element of segments with storygame.runtime.contracts.NarrationSegment. Row fields: ok (all segments valid and selected_knowledge_ids a list of str), bad_segments (list of {index, keys, kind_value capped at 40 chars if a str, error_types}), stray_selected_ids (true if a segment object has only the key selected_knowledge_ids), invalid_kind (true if a segment's kind is a str outside the three allowed). Write DIR/summary.json: calls, per-cell counts of rows, ok, bad rows, stray_selected_ids, invalid_kind, errors, plus the distinct invalid kind values seen. Also write the raw body of every non-ok row to DIR/bad/<cell>-<rep>.txt.
3. --dry-run does the prompt capture only, writes the prompts and a summary with calls 0, and makes no network call. Without --confirm and without --dry-run, refuse with a message.
4. TESTS in scripts/ringer/stage7/test_segment_replay_probe.py (no network): the classifier flags a stray {selected_knowledge_ids:[...]} segment, an invalid kind such as 'thought', and a clean reply; the cap logic refuses n over 20 and never exceeds 60 calls (use a fake sender); --confirm is required for the live path.
HOW TO RUN: run the tests, ruff check and ruff format --check on both files, then `--n 1 --dry-run --out bench/results/stage7-segment-replay-dry` and read DIR/prompts/*.json to confirm three distinct prompts were captured. Write DIR/notes.md (about 80 words, factual): where the reveal prompt shows the offered reveal, and the prompt token sizes. Do not run --confirm.
tasks.check: cd /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge && export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp && .venv/bin/python -m pytest scripts/ringer/stage7 -q -n0 > /tmp/sr.out 2>&1; tail -4 /tmp/sr.out; grep -q ' passed' /tmp/sr.out && ! grep -q ' failed\| error' /tmp/sr.out && for c in reveal dialogue plain; do test -s bench/results/stage7-segment-replay-dry/prompts/$c.json || { echo missing prompt $c; exit 1; }; done && .venv/bin/python -c "import json;a=[json.load(open('bench/results/stage7-segment-replay-dry/prompts/%s.json'%c))['user'] for c in ('reveal','dialogue','plain')];assert len(set(a))==3,'prompts not distinct';assert 'k_sl_2b_a_r1' in a[0],'reveal prompt lacks k_sl_2b_a_r1'" && .venv/bin/ruff check scripts/ringer/stage7/segment_replay_probe.py scripts/ringer/stage7/test_segment_replay_probe.py && .venv/bin/ruff format --check scripts/ringer/stage7/segment_replay_probe.py scripts/ringer/stage7/test_segment_replay_probe.py && ! .venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/stage7/segment_replay_probe.py --n 1 --out /tmp/sr-noconfirm > /tmp/sr-nc.out 2>&1 || { echo 'FAIL: see output above'; exit 1; }
tasks.verified: Three distinct narrator prompts are captured offline (reveal prompt offers k_sl_2b_a_r1), the classifier is unit-tested, caps and --confirm are enforced, and no network call was made.
